title: Pin the documented lexical spelling of terminal fixture TEMP and TMP paths
outcome: The terminal child-temp fixture test covers the documented returned path spelling from test_temp_dir(), alongside exact physical directory identity and existing refusal/cleanup controls.
acceptance: Add an assertion of each returned TEMP/TMP lexical path against test_temp_dir().join(created root file_name).join("child-temp"), preserving the helper's documented no-verbatim-prefix spelling contract on Windows and intentional OS alias spelling on Unix.

Keep exact canonical child-directory identity, TEMP/TMP name checks, no nested-workdir child-temp, linked/outside-root refusal and cleanup behavior; validate using the standard focused check and review for the resulting input.
